# Version 4.155.0
> **Decoder and interop updates** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.500/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 removes RAW and DNG decoding while updating GLES interop and bundled text shaping.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — GLES interop signatures now pass native data through pointer-based parameters for direct native interoperation. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))
- **RAW and DNG image decoding disabled** — The bundled decoder no longer opens RAW and DNG image formats. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.4.0** — Refreshes the bundled text-shaping engine to HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.500

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 22, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the 4.155 line with the Skia m155 engine update.
